# readme-3d

> Put interactive, rotatable 3D models in your GitHub README. Converts GLB, glTF, OBJ, and binary STL into the ASCII STL markdown blocks GitHub renders natively - with mesh simplification to fit the 512 KB markdown budget.

readme-3d is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y readme-3d`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/readme-3d/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/readme-3d/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/readme-3d/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/readme-3d/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
